player_prompt.intro:
Nga ni Player {player_id} mu **Ultimate Tic Tac Toe**.
Somete inkweto yawe kwa njia ya **[macro  micro]** (nambari mbili 0-8):
• *macro*  = ni mini-bodi gani ulemba
• *micro* = ni square gani mule mini-bodi
Mfano `[7 8]` ➜ weka alama yawe mule mini-bodi 7, square 8, na
kuleta mpinzani wako aleme mule mini-bodi 8 inayofuata.

Nga ni `{symbol}`.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ukupoka kwafwile ukuba mu musango wa [macro micro] na manambala 0-8.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ifyakulembapo fyonse fifwile ukuba pakati ka 0 na 8.
invalid_move.wrong_micro_board: Uuleteya afwile ukulalisha pa cibokoshi icikalamba icili mupepi.
invalid_move.micro_board_won: Icilye ca micro board calicimfiwa kale.

game_action.played: Player {player_id} aleme mule micro-bodi {macro_idx}, seli {micro_idx} (safu {row}, safu wima {col}). Player {opponent_id} anabidi aleme sasa mule {nxt_txt}.

outcome.win: Umulayi {player_id} alicimfya mu Ultimate Tic Tac Toe!
